Player forecasts are well calibrated. On the holdout, predicted buckets landed within about 3 points of actual hit rates. The test used who actually played, so live forecasts will be slightly worse because inactives are unknown in advance.

Game lines show no edge. Closing spread MAE was 9.70 points vs 10.11 for our line, and the fitted weight on our line was about zero. Closing totals: 10.18 vs 10.61. So game sides default to pass.

Prop edges are unproven. Calibration shows the probabilities are honest. It does not show they beat DraftKings, because no historical prop lines were available to test against. The edges here are leads to price-check.

2026 holdout, all markets. Dots near the dashed line mean a forecast of X% hit about X% of the time. Bigger dots hold more forecasts.

Data gaps

  • Prop prices: ESPN's DraftKings feed gives lines and milestone levels but no prices. Moneyline, spread and total prices are real. Prop edges assume -110, and each pick shows a minimum acceptable price.
  • 2026 coverage: man/zone and coverage shells have no free 2026 feed. 2025 charting stands in, labeled every time, and flagged when a head coach changed. Coordinator changes are not tracked.
  • Alignment and routes: 2026 slot/wide alignment and routes run are paid data. Target side, depth and 2025 route targets stand in. Press rate, shadow rate, tackle-vs-edge win rate, and run-scheme splits are left out.
  • Under-pressure splits: team pressure rates are 2026 (PFR). Individual QB pressure splits are 2025. Blitz splits are 2026 (FTN).
  • Injury odds: P(plays) values are assumptions from status and practice, not fitted estimates.

nflverse supplied play-by-play, FTN charting, PFR advanced stats, NGS, snap counts, depth charts and rosters. ESPN supplied the schedule, injuries and DraftKings lines. NWS supplied forecasts.

These are estimates, and no selection is guaranteed. After the games, run review.py to score every forecast (Phase 15).

Ranked by the calibrated model chance after the red-zone matchup is applied, so a receiver who draws a big share of red-zone targets against a defense that leaks red-zone passing TDs can rank above a running back. The model chance is calibrated. The matchup adjustment was backtested on 5,922 past forecasts (2025 and the 2026 holdout) and did not improve them: players it marked down still scored at or above the model's rate, and its top 5 hit no more often than the model's. Read it as context, not as an edge. Defensive rates are blended with 40 plays of league average to keep small samples from swinging it. Players listed Out, Doubtful or IR are excluded.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Cedric Johnson (DE, Questionable), James Pearce Jr. (LB, Questionable), Divine Deablo (LB, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: Joe Burrow and Michael Penix Jr.. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: Chase Brown 15+ rushing yds (95%) + Bijan Robinson 40+ rushing yds (92%). Joint estimate 86.6%, fair -647. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 83.0% vs 83.1% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Chase Brown 30+ rushing yds (79%) + Jahan Dotson 10+ receiving yds (79%) + Joe Burrow 220+ passing yds (79%). Joint estimate 50.6%, fair -102. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 42.3% vs 41.8% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Joe Burrow 260+ passing yds (62%) + Bijan Robinson 80+ rushing yds (59%) + Dohnte Meyers 10+ receiving yds (57%). Joint estimate 23.2%, fair +332. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 17.4% vs 15.8% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

Conservative, balanced, aggressive

Conservative: Chase Brown 15+ rushing yds (95%) + Bijan Robinson 40+ rushing yds (92%). Joint estimate 86.6%, fair -647. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 83.0% vs 83.1% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Chase Brown 30+ rushing yds (79%) + Jahan Dotson 10+ receiving yds (79%) + Joe Burrow 220+ passing yds (79%). Joint estimate 50.6%, fair -102. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 42.3% vs 41.8% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Joe Burrow 260+ passing yds (62%) + Bijan Robinson 80+ rushing yds (59%) + Dohnte Meyers 10+ receiving yds (57%). Joint estimate 23.2%, fair +332. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 17.4% vs 15.8% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Ranked by the calibrated model chance after the red-zone matchup is applied, so a receiver who draws a big share of red-zone targets against a defense that leaks red-zone passing TDs can rank above a running back. The model chance is calibrated. The matchup adjustment was backtested on 5,922 past forecasts (2025 and the 2026 holdout) and did not improve them: players it marked down still scored at or above the model's rate, and its top 5 hit no more often than the model's. Read it as context, not as an edge. Defensive rates are blended with 40 plays of league average to keep small samples from swinging it. Players listed Out, Doubtful or IR are excluded.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Jake Ferguson (TE, Questionable), George Pickens (WR, Questionable), Tyler Smith (G, Questionable), DeMarvion Overshown (LB, Questionable), Caleb Downs (S, Questionable), Drew Ogletree (TE, Questionable), Akeem Davis-Gaither (LB, Questionable), Justin Walley (CB, Questionable), Anthony Gould (WR, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: Dak Prescott and Daniel Jones. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: CeeDee Lamb 30+ receiving yds (91%) + Keenan Allen 10+ receiving yds (91%). Joint estimate 82.8%, fair -483. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 74.7% vs 74.5% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Dak Prescott 200+ passing yds (80%) + Josh Downs 15+ receiving yds (80%) + Keenan Allen 20+ receiving yds (79%). Joint estimate 51.1%, fair -104. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 38.1% vs 37.4% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Daniel Jones 200+ passing yds (61%) + Jonathan Taylor 10+ receiving yds (61%) + CeeDee Lamb 70+ receiving yds (61%). Joint estimate 26.6%, fair +276. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 18.5% vs 15.7% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

Conservative, balanced, aggressive

Conservative: CeeDee Lamb 30+ receiving yds (91%) + Keenan Allen 10+ receiving yds (91%). Joint estimate 82.8%, fair -483. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 74.7% vs 74.5% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Dak Prescott 200+ passing yds (80%) + Josh Downs 15+ receiving yds (80%) + Keenan Allen 20+ receiving yds (79%). Joint estimate 51.1%, fair -104. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 38.1% vs 37.4% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Daniel Jones 200+ passing yds (61%) + Jonathan Taylor 10+ receiving yds (61%) + CeeDee Lamb 70+ receiving yds (61%). Joint estimate 26.6%, fair +276. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 18.5% vs 15.7% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Ranked by the calibrated model chance after the red-zone matchup is applied, so a receiver who draws a big share of red-zone targets against a defense that leaks red-zone passing TDs can rank above a running back. The model chance is calibrated. The matchup adjustment was backtested on 5,922 past forecasts (2025 and the 2026 holdout) and did not improve them: players it marked down still scored at or above the model's rate, and its top 5 hit no more often than the model's. Read it as context, not as an edge. Defensive rates are blended with 40 plays of league average to keep small samples from swinging it. Players listed Out, Doubtful or IR are excluded.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Joseph Ossai (DE, Questionable), Harrison Phillips (DT, Questionable), Mansoor Delane (CB, Questionable), Peter Woods (DT, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: Geno Smith and Patrick Mahomes. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: Kenneth Walker III 40+ rushing yds (92%) + Adonai Mitchell 10+ receiving yds (90%). Joint estimate 83.8%, fair -516. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 77.5% vs 77.4% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Patrick Mahomes 190+ passing yds (80%) + Kenneth Walker III 60+ rushing yds (79%) + Geno Smith 180+ passing yds (78%). Joint estimate 51.0%, fair -104. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 41.4% vs 39.7% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Xavier Worthy 25+ receiving yds (62%) + Braelon Allen 35+ rushing yds (61%) + Patrick Mahomes 230+ passing yds (61%). Joint estimate 27.4%, fair +265. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 18.5% vs 15.7% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

Player main lines
Lines are real DraftKings numbers, but ESPN's feed has no prop prices. Edge assumes -110 and is not a verified EV. Shrunk side first removes the slate-wide tilt in that market, then pulls our probability halfway to the line (log-odds), because we cannot prove the model beats the prop market. Min odds is the worst price worth taking, with a 2-point cushion. Check role marks a median more than 33% from the line, or a 20-point snap swing in the latest game. Either usually means usage history lags a real role change, so we do not count it as an edge.

Conservative, balanced, aggressive

Conservative: Kenneth Walker III 40+ rushing yds (92%) + Adonai Mitchell 10+ receiving yds (90%). Joint estimate 83.8%, fair -516. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 77.5% vs 77.4% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Patrick Mahomes 190+ passing yds (80%) + Kenneth Walker III 60+ rushing yds (79%) + Geno Smith 180+ passing yds (78%). Joint estimate 51.0%, fair -104. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 41.4% vs 39.7% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Xavier Worthy 25+ receiving yds (62%) + Braelon Allen 35+ rushing yds (61%) + Patrick Mahomes 230+ passing yds (61%). Joint estimate 27.4%, fair +265. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 18.5% vs 15.7% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Ranked by the calibrated model chance after the red-zone matchup is applied, so a receiver who draws a big share of red-zone targets against a defense that leaks red-zone passing TDs can rank above a running back. The model chance is calibrated. The matchup adjustment was backtested on 5,922 past forecasts (2025 and the 2026 holdout) and did not improve them: players it marked down still scored at or above the model's rate, and its top 5 hit no more often than the model's. Read it as context, not as an edge. Defensive rates are blended with 40 plays of league average to keep small samples from swinging it. Players listed Out, Doubtful or IR are excluded.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Brian Branch (S, Questionable), Amon-Ra St. Brown (WR, Questionable), Jack Campbell (LB, Doubtful), Jaylen Wright (RB, Questionable), Kadyn Proctor (OT, Questionable), Malik Herring (DE, Questionable), Kaytron Allen (RB, Questionable), Will Kacmarek (TE, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: Jared Goff and Malik Willis. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: Jameson Williams 10+ receiving yds (92%) + Jahmyr Gibbs 40+ rushing yds (91%). Joint estimate 84.3%, fair -535. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 78.5% vs 78.5% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Malik Washington 20+ receiving yds (80%) + Malik Willis 170+ passing yds (79%) + Jameson Williams 25+ receiving yds (79%). Joint estimate 54.7%, fair -121. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 40.9% vs 37.5% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Jared Goff 259+ passing yds (61%) + Chris Bell 15+ receiving yds (61%) + Greg Dulcich 30+ receiving yds (60%). Joint estimate 23.2%, fair +332. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 16.0% vs 15.4% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

The matchup adjustment was backtested on 5,922 past forecasts (2025 and the 2026 holdout) and did not improve them: players it marked down still scored at or above the model's rate, and its top 5 hit no more often than the model's. Read it as context, not as an edge. Defensive rates are blended with 40 plays of league average to keep small samples from swinging it. Players listed Out, Doubtful or IR are excluded.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Harold Fannin Jr. (TE, Questionable), Deshaun Watson (QB, Questionable), Quincy Williams (LB, Questionable), Denzel Boston (WR, Questionable), Emmanuel McNeil-Warren (S, Questionable), CJ Donaldson (RB, Questionable), Alvin Kamara (RB, Questionable), Justin Reid (S, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: Deshaun Watson and Tyler Shough. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: Chris Olave 25+ receiving yds (88%) + Tyler Shough 150+ passing yds (85%). Joint estimate 79.9%, fair -397. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 70.4% vs 66.1% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: not enough legs at this risk level with a posted milestone.

Aggressive: not enough legs at this risk level with a posted milestone.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

Ranked by the calibrated model chance after the red-zone matchup is applied, so a receiver who draws a big share of red-zone targets against a defense that leaks red-zone passing TDs can rank above a running back. The model chance is calibrated. The matchup adjustment was backtested on 5,922 past forecasts (2025 and the 2026 holdout) and did not improve them: players it marked down still scored at or above the model's rate, and its top 5 hit no more often than the model's. Read it as context, not as an edge. Defensive rates are blended with 40 plays of league average to keep small samples from swinging it. Players listed Out, Doubtful or IR are excluded.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Cam Skattebo (RB, Questionable), Malik Nabers (WR, Questionable), Jermaine Eluemunor (OT, Questionable), Andrew Thomas (OT, Questionable), Darius Alexander (DT, Questionable), DeVonta Smith (WR, Questionable), Dontayvion Wicks (WR, Questionable), Saquon Barkley (RB, Questionable), Jake Elliott (PK, Questionable), Tanner McKee (QB, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: J.J. McCarthy and Tanner McKee. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: Isaiah Likely 10+ receiving yds (93%) + J.J. McCarthy 150+ passing yds (87%). Joint estimate 82.8%, fair -482. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 75.2% vs 73.2% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: J.J. McCarthy 170+ passing yds (78%) + Isaiah Likely 25+ receiving yds (77%) + Malachi Fields 10+ receiving yds (74%). Joint estimate 52.7%, fair -112. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 41.0% vs 34.8% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: J.J. McCarthy 200+ passing yds (62%) + Darnell Mooney 10+ receiving yds (60%) + Malachi Fields 20+ receiving yds (56%). Joint estimate 28.7%, fair +248. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 22.3% vs 16.3% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Colby Parkinson (TE, Questionable), Trent McDuffie (CB, Questionable), Kam Curl (S, Questionable), Dyami Brown (WR, Questionable), Treylon Burks (WR, Questionable), Shy Tuttle (DT, Questionable), John Bates (TE, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: Matthew Stafford and Jayden Daniels. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: Matthew Stafford 160+ passing yds (93%) + Kyren Williams 20+ rushing yds (92%). Joint estimate 86.0%, fair -615. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 81.1% vs 81.1% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Blake Corum 20+ rushing yds (80%) + Puka Nacua 60+ receiving yds (79%) + Matthew Stafford 210+ passing yds (76%). Joint estimate 55.5%, fair -125. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 43.2% vs 37.3% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Matthew Stafford 240+ passing yds (61%) + Kyren Williams 50+ rushing yds (60%) + Puka Nacua 90+ receiving yds (56%). Joint estimate 29.7%, fair +237. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 19.5% vs 13.3% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Talanoa Hufanga (S, Questionable), Kris Abrams-Draine (CB, Questionable), Eyioma Uwazurike (DE, Questionable), Brandon Jones (S, Questionable), Damien Lewis (G, Questionable), Will Lee III (CB, Questionable), Bobby Okereke (LB, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: Bo Nix and Bryce Young. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: Tetairoa McMillan 20+ receiving yds (92%) + Chuba Hubbard 25+ rushing yds (92%). Joint estimate 84.6%, fair -551. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 78.9% vs 78.8% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Bryce Young 180+ passing yds (80%) + Chuba Hubbard 40+ rushing yds (78%) + Bo Nix 150+ passing yds (78%). Joint estimate 50.4%, fair -102. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 40.8% vs 39.4% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Evan Engram 10+ receiving yds (61%) + Courtland Sutton 25+ receiving yds (61%) + Bo Nix 180+ passing yds (61%). Joint estimate 30.8%, fair +225. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 21.4% vs 15.7% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

Player main lines
Lines are real DraftKings numbers, but ESPN's feed has no prop prices. Edge assumes -110 and is not a verified EV. Shrunk side first removes the slate-wide tilt in that market, then pulls our probability halfway to the line (log-odds), because we cannot prove the model beats the prop market. Min odds is the worst price worth taking, with a 2-point cushion. Check role marks a median more than 33% from the line, or a 20-point snap swing in the latest game. Either usually means usage history lags a real role change, so we do not count it as an edge.

Conservative, balanced, aggressive

Conservative: Tetairoa McMillan 20+ receiving yds (92%) + Chuba Hubbard 25+ rushing yds (92%). Joint estimate 84.6%, fair -551. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 78.9% vs 78.8% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Bryce Young 180+ passing yds (80%) + Chuba Hubbard 40+ rushing yds (78%) + Bo Nix 150+ passing yds (78%). Joint estimate 50.4%, fair -102. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 40.8% vs 39.4% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Evan Engram 10+ receiving yds (61%) + Courtland Sutton 25+ receiving yds (61%) + Bo Nix 180+ passing yds (61%). Joint estimate 30.8%, fair +225. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 21.4% vs 15.7% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Reed Blankenship (S, Questionable), Kendall Williamson (S, Questionable), Brenen Thompson (WR, Doubtful), Rodney Shelley (CB, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: C.J. Stroud and Justin Herbert. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: Dalton Schultz 10+ receiving yds (86%) + Nico Collins 20+ receiving yds (82%). Joint estimate 70.7%, fair -241. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 59.4% vs 59.3% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: C.J. Stroud 170+ passing yds (80%) + Justin Herbert 150+ passing yds (80%) + Dalton Schultz 15+ receiving yds (79%). Joint estimate 56.0%, fair -127. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 43.4% vs 39.1% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Tre Harris 15+ receiving yds (61%) + Justin Herbert 180+ passing yds (61%) + C.J. Stroud 210+ passing yds (59%). Joint estimate 27.3%, fair +267. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 20.7% vs 16.7% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

Player main lines
Lines are real DraftKings numbers, but ESPN's feed has no prop prices. Edge assumes -110 and is not a verified EV. Shrunk side first removes the slate-wide tilt in that market, then pulls our probability halfway to the line (log-odds), because we cannot prove the model beats the prop market. Min odds is the worst price worth taking, with a 2-point cushion. Check role marks a median more than 33% from the line, or a 20-point snap swing in the latest game. Either usually means usage history lags a real role change, so we do not count it as an edge.

Conservative, balanced, aggressive

Conservative: Dalton Schultz 10+ receiving yds (86%) + Nico Collins 20+ receiving yds (82%). Joint estimate 70.7%, fair -241. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 59.4% vs 59.3% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: C.J. Stroud 170+ passing yds (80%) + Justin Herbert 150+ passing yds (80%) + Dalton Schultz 15+ receiving yds (79%). Joint estimate 56.0%, fair -127. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 43.4% vs 39.1% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Tre Harris 15+ receiving yds (61%) + Justin Herbert 180+ passing yds (61%) + C.J. Stroud 210+ passing yds (59%). Joint estimate 27.3%, fair +267. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 20.7% vs 16.7% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Travis Glover (OT, Questionable), Sean Rhyan (G, Questionable), Aaron Banks (G, Questionable), MarShawn Lloyd (RB, Questionable), Christian Watson (WR, Questionable), A.J. Brown (WR, Questionable), Hunter Henry (TE, Questionable), TreVeyon Henderson (RB, Questionable), Brenden Schooler (S, Questionable), Marcus Jones (CB, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: Jordan Love and Drake Maye. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: Drake Maye 150+ passing yds (90%) + Matthew Golden 20+ receiving yds (86%). Joint estimate 78.0%, fair -355. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 69.2% vs 68.9% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Drake Maye 180+ passing yds (79%) + Tucker Kraft 15+ receiving yds (77%) + Matthew Golden 30+ receiving yds (77%). Joint estimate 47.2%, fair +112. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 34.4% vs 33.9% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Tucker Kraft 25+ receiving yds (60%) + Jordan Love 220+ passing yds (60%) + Drake Maye 20+ rushing yds (59%). Joint estimate 24.8%, fair +303. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 16.5% vs 14.1% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

Player main lines
Lines are real DraftKings numbers, but ESPN's feed has no prop prices. Edge assumes -110 and is not a verified EV. Shrunk side first removes the slate-wide tilt in that market, then pulls our probability halfway to the line (log-odds), because we cannot prove the model beats the prop market. Min odds is the worst price worth taking, with a 2-point cushion. Check role marks a median more than 33% from the line, or a 20-point snap swing in the latest game. Either usually means usage history lags a real role change, so we do not count it as an edge.

Conservative, balanced, aggressive

Conservative: Drake Maye 150+ passing yds (90%) + Matthew Golden 20+ receiving yds (86%). Joint estimate 78.0%, fair -355. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 69.2% vs 68.9% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Drake Maye 180+ passing yds (79%) + Tucker Kraft 15+ receiving yds (77%) + Matthew Golden 30+ receiving yds (77%). Joint estimate 47.2%, fair +112. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 34.4% vs 33.9% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Tucker Kraft 25+ receiving yds (60%) + Jordan Love 220+ passing yds (60%) + Drake Maye 20+ rushing yds (59%). Joint estimate 24.8%, fair +303. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 16.5% vs 14.1% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Ranked by the calibrated model chance after the red-zone matchup is applied, so a receiver who draws a big share of red-zone targets against a defense that leaks red-zone passing TDs can rank above a running back. The matchup adjustment was backtested on 5,922 past forecasts (2025 and the 2026 holdout) and did not improve them: players it marked down still scored at or above the model's rate, and its top 5 hit no more often than the model's. Read it as context, not as an edge. Defensive rates are blended with 40 plays of league average to keep small samples from swinging it. Players listed Out, Doubtful or IR are excluded.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Dont'e Thornton Jr. (WR, Questionable), Thomas Booker IV (DT, Questionable), Darien Porter (CB, Questionable), Christian Kirk (WR, Questionable), Deebo Samuel Sr. (WR, Questionable), Mike Evans (WR, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: Kirk Cousins and Brock Purdy. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: Kirk Cousins 160+ passing yds (91%) + Tre Tucker 10+ receiving yds (88%). Joint estimate 82.8%, fair -482. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 74.3% vs 71.9% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: George Kittle 25+ receiving yds (79%) + Tre Tucker 20+ receiving yds (78%) + Michael Mayer 10+ receiving yds (77%). Joint estimate 47.4%, fair +111. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 35.9% vs 35.8% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Christian McCaffrey 25+ receiving yds (60%) + Kirk Cousins 230+ passing yds (59%) + Michael Mayer 20+ receiving yds (59%). Joint estimate 25.2%, fair +297. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 17.4% vs 14.5% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

Player main lines
Lines are real DraftKings numbers, but ESPN's feed has no prop prices. Edge assumes -110 and is not a verified EV. Shrunk side first removes the slate-wide tilt in that market, then pulls our probability halfway to the line (log-odds), because we cannot prove the model beats the prop market. Min odds is the worst price worth taking, with a 2-point cushion. Check role marks a median more than 33% from the line, or a 20-point snap swing in the latest game. Either usually means usage history lags a real role change, so we do not count it as an edge.

Conservative, balanced, aggressive

Conservative: Kirk Cousins 160+ passing yds (91%) + Tre Tucker 10+ receiving yds (88%). Joint estimate 82.8%, fair -482. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 74.3% vs 71.9% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: George Kittle 25+ receiving yds (79%) + Tre Tucker 20+ receiving yds (78%) + Michael Mayer 10+ receiving yds (77%). Joint estimate 47.4%, fair +111. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 35.9% vs 35.8% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Christian McCaffrey 25+ receiving yds (60%) + Kirk Cousins 230+ passing yds (59%) + Michael Mayer 20+ receiving yds (59%). Joint estimate 25.2%, fair +297. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 17.4% vs 14.5% if independent. Not guaranteed.

DraftKings via ESPN, pulled Friday, Nov 6 at 12:56 PM. Sun Nov 8, 4:25 PM ET · Lumen Field.

Jeremiyah Love (ankle) went on IR Nov 3, James Conner (foot, IR) won't return this week, and Bam Knight (concussion) did not practice Thursday and is questionable (ESPN, citing Darren Urban). Tyler Allgeier's share should grow, so Arizona rushing lines are held out.

Sam Darnold (quad) is ruled out; coach Mike Macdonald said the plan is for Drew Lock to start, with Jalen Milroe as backup (ESPN injury page; Spokesman-Review/NBC Sports, Nov 4-5). Lock was limited all week with a right elbow injury and is listed questionable, so if he can't go Milroe makes his first NFL start. Seattle passing and receiving lines rest on Lock's small 2026 sample.

Defensive scheme

SEA defense vs ARI offense: what to attack

  • SEA is soft on Short 0-9 throws to the left (+0.17 EPA/att vs league +0.03, 68 attempts).
  • Avoid Inter 10-19 throws to the right: SEA allows -0.76 EPA/att vs league +0.38 (14 attempts).
  • Pressure mismatch favors SEA: its 27% pressure rate meets a ARI line allowing 25% (league 22%).
  • SEA limits WR1 (most targets) to 47 yds/game (league 71).
  • SEA limits WR3 to 10 yds/game (league 23).
  • SEA limits All TE to 38 yds/game (league 55).
  • Run stuffed: Inside (middle / guard) gains only 3.0 YPC on SEA (league 3.8).
  • Run stuffed: Outside (tackle / end) gains only 3.9 YPC on SEA (league 4.6).

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Jayden Williams (OT, Questionable), Jon Gaines II (G, Questionable), Max Melton (CB, Questionable), Quenton Nelson (G, Questionable), Charles Cross (OT, Questionable), Leonard Williams (DT, Questionable), Ernest Jones IV (LB, Questionable), Derick Hall (LB, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: Gardner Minshew and Drew Lock. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: not enough legs at this risk level with a posted milestone.

Balanced: not enough legs at this risk level with a posted milestone.

Aggressive: not enough legs at this risk level with a posted milestone.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

ARI strengths: rushing EPA on defense (#4). Weaknesses: explosive passing on offense (#31); passing EPA on defense (#31); red-zone TDs on offense (#30); explosive passing on defense (#29); overall EPA on defense (#26).

SEA strengths: explosive passing on defense (#1); success rate on defense (#2); 3rd downs on defense (#3); explosive runs on defense (#4); overall EPA on defense (#5). Weaknesses: red-zone TDs on defense (#32); red-zone TDs on offense (#29); rushing EPA on offense (#29); 3rd downs on offense (#27); success rate on offense (#26).

Jeremiyah Love (ankle) went on IR Nov 3, James Conner (foot, IR) won't return this week, and Bam Knight (concussion) did not practice Thursday and is questionable (ESPN, citing Darren Urban). Tyler Allgeier's share should grow, so Arizona rushing lines are held out.

Sam Darnold (quad) is ruled out; coach Mike Macdonald said the plan is for Drew Lock to start, with Jalen Milroe as backup (ESPN injury page; Spokesman-Review/NBC Sports, Nov 4-5). Lock was limited all week with a right elbow injury and is listed questionable, so if he can't go Milroe makes his first NFL start. Seattle passing and receiving lines rest on Lock's small 2026 sample.

Key injuries and uncertainties: Jayden Williams (OT, Questionable); Jon Gaines II (G, Questionable); Max Melton (CB, Questionable); Bam Knight (RB, Out); Quenton Nelson (G, Questionable); Charles Cross (OT, Questionable); Leonard Williams (DT, Questionable); Ernest Jones IV (LB, Questionable); Derick Hall (LB, Questionable).

Ranked by the calibrated model chance after the red-zone matchup is applied, so a receiver who draws a big share of red-zone targets against a defense that leaks red-zone passing TDs can rank above a running back. The model chance is calibrated. The matchup adjustment was backtested on 5,922 past forecasts (2025 and the 2026 holdout) and did not improve them: players it marked down still scored at or above the model's rate, and its top 5 hit no more often than the model's. Read it as context, not as an edge. Defensive rates are blended with 40 plays of league average to keep small samples from swinging it. Players listed Out, Doubtful or IR are excluded.

Before kickoff

  1. Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Rerun the slate after they do, and drop any pick whose player or key teammate is out.
  2. Questionable or doubtful: Emeka Egbuka (WR, Questionable), Tristan Wirfs (OT, Questionable), Tykee Smith (S, Questionable), D'Marco Jackson (LB, Questionable), Kyle Monangai (RB, Questionable).
  3. Confirm the starting QBs: Baker Mayfield and Caleb Williams. A change moves every passing and receiving line.
  4. Check the line has not moved past the minimum price shown. If it has, skip the pick rather than chase it.
  5. Check the kickoff forecast for 15+ mph wind or heavy rain. The market total usually moves first; if it drops 3+ points, rerun.

Building a parlay

  • Two or three legs. Each extra leg multiplies the risk: three 75% legs land together only about 42% of the time if independent.
  • Each leg at 70% or better from the Most likely tier, and no questionable players or QB-change teams.
  • Use the joint estimate, not the product. Same-game legs move together. A QB yardage over and his WR1 over are positively correlated; two receivers on one team partly compete for the same targets.
  • Price check: a parlay is worth taking only if its payout beats the fair odds of the joint estimate.

Conservative: Rome Odunze 10+ receiving yds (92%) + Luther Burden III 15+ receiving yds (91%). Joint estimate 84.4%, fair -539. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 76.8% vs 76.8% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: D'Andre Swift 30+ rushing yds (80%) + Rome Odunze 25+ receiving yds (79%) + Luther Burden III 30+ receiving yds (79%). Joint estimate 50.5%, fair -102. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 38.2% vs 37.9% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: D'Andre Swift 10+ receiving yds (62%) + Kenny Gainwell 20+ rushing yds (61%) + Kalif Raymond 15+ receiving yds (61%). Joint estimate 23.0%, fair +334. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 17.9% vs 18.0% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive breaks the 70% rule on purpose, for comparison.

Min odds is the worst price worth taking, with a 2-point cushion. Check role marks a median more than 33% from the line, or a 20-point snap swing in the latest game.
